notes.title: Outcast sequel A New Beginning has a release date, almost 25 years after the original sci-fi adventure game
notes.notes:
Outcast: A New Beginning is gearing up to drop its long-awaited sequel to the nineties sci-fi adventure game, with its newly-announced release date landing almost a quarter of a century after its predecessor. If you’re new, or have just forgotten what happened in the first Outcast - of which there’s a good chance given that time gap - you should apparently still be able to jump in here.

Read more

notes.title: Outcast 1.1 hot update version 1.1.6.18976
notes.notes:
This hot update fixes some triggering issues with some quest's achievements and support several new missing achievements which were not exposed.

This updates also fixes a potential crash when exiting the game.

For those who have already completed the quests related to these achievements, normally, these achievements should unlock properly the next time you run the game with this update.

Thanks again for your sustained report and feedback!

notes.title: Outcast 1.1 hot update version 1.1.6.18970
notes.notes:
This hot update fixes the following gameplay/achievements issues. Many thanks for your awesome feedback and reporting : )

[list]
[*] Fix the Fae fruits vanishing from backpack

[*] In a specific context, if was not possible to give the Gorgor tooth to Martigar (this bug was in the original game)

[*] In Motazaar, the dialogs related to the "collapsed mines" were not properly raised (was inadvertely removed during a  code refactoring)

[*] "Hypocondriac!" achievement was triggering at 20 instead of 100

[*] The achievements counter related to the weapon merchants have been resized from 10 to 9 (actually there's one weapon merchant per district). The 10th weapon merchant is a just a 1999's myth!  ;)

[/list]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/outcast/announcements/detail/129817471131936824]More info on version 1.1.6  introducing achievements[/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/336610/discussions/0/626329820860443987/]Release notes history[/url]

notes.title: Outcast 1.1 has been updated to version 1.1.5
notes.notes:
Dear Adelphians, 
 
We're proud to announce this major update of Outcast 1.1 featuring a boost of performance and nice improvements such as: unlocked resolution, unconstrained camera, extended visibility range, reduced poping and artefacts, new camera and fog settings as part of many other fixes in term of gameplay and stability. 

I hope you'll enjoy these improvements and take this opportunity to thank you all for your awesome feedback and your kind recommendations :).

Yann

[h1]Version 1.1.5.18872[/h1]
[List]
[*] fixed: an issue with the brain manager allowing to finish the game without finding all the mons
[*] fixed: a performance drop and a potential crash in Okaar and Shamazaar 
[*] fixed: a graphics issue when switching the weapon level in 1st person using the FT 74X (flame thrower)
[*] fixed: a missing  audio message when the advisor is locating HAWK MK8 ammo 
[*] fixed: some missing quest reward items (mainly the remote detonators such as THNDR-STP33 and CLAPR-T)
[/List]

[h1]Version 1.1.5.18871[/h1]

[b]Graphics Enhancements:[/b]
[List]
[*] new: unlock camera constraint in 1st person and 3rd person
[*] new: unlock resolution limitations 
[*] new: support 21:9 resolution 
[*] new: extend the visibility range, reduce distant view poping artefacts
[*] new: properly tweak the fog to comply with the mood of the original game
[*] new: extend the skyes according the new camera range
[*] new: extend the NPC visibility and activity range (together with the new camera settings and the extended view, this should let you discover some unseen aspect of the AI)
[*] new: tweak the 3rd person camera settings to provide a new strategic view point
[*] new: add the ability to pause the dialog to read the subtitle (by keeping pressed the main button)
[/List]


[b]Performance boost:[/b]
To compensate the unlocking of the resolution, the camera freedom and the extended visibility range, we had to focus on various optimisations which results in a noticeable performance boost specially on multithreaded machine. 
[List]
[*] new: multithreaded fog and water post-process
[*] new: multithreaded polygon rendering 
[*] new: rewritting rasterizer to take advantage of SSE technology instead of MMX and making it thread independent
[*] new: improved thread affinity and dispatch
[/List]


[b]Gameplay fixes[/b]
[List]
[*] fixed: potential stuck in dialog (ie with zeo or zagrad)
[*] fixed: transmission of the 4th mon could fail
[*] fixed: minimap scaling was not resolution independent
[*] fixed: can't use E character in savegame name
[/List]


[b]Graphics fixes:[/b]
[List]
[*] fixed: sometimes background disappeared on specific camera angles (mainly in 1920x1080)
[*] fixed: highly reduce visibility popping 
[*] fixed: remove artifacts related to zbuffer precision (ie visible on Cutter helmet in 1920x1080)
[/List]


[b]Crash fixes:[/b]
[List]
[*] fixed: potential crash while changing world
[*] fixed: potential crash while rendering shadows in 1920x1080
[*] fixed: potential crash when leaving the Okaar map
[*] fixed: steamCloud issue: the name of the savegame was discard by SteamServer since the file was empty
[/List]


[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/336610/discussions/0/626329820860443987/]Release notes history[/url]

notes.title: Outcast 1.1 has been updated to version 1.1.3.18756
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.1.3.18756[/h1]

This update fixed a major issue related to vsync management . The native fullscreen mode is now working as expected (should be more performant than any windowed modes)

From that version, to achieve the best performance and quality we recommend to select [b]"native" fullscreen mode[/b] and [b]enabling the vsync[/b]. You should have a noticeable performance gain toward the "windowless fullscreen mode".

notes.title: Outcast 1.1 has been updated to version 1.1.3.18753
notes.notes:
Dear Adelphians,

We recently updated the version of Outcast 1.1 with some major improvements in term of stability, performance and bug trackings. We got a very busy week thus we couldn't  include the achievements in this release, but it should come soon :)

Thanks again for being there and supporting us! 

[h1]Version 1.1.3.18753[/h1]

[List]
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Potential crashes due to antialiasing buffer overrun
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Water rendering artefact due to multithreading contention
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] On some configuration (mainly Windows 8.1), the Launcher could not display the buttons at the right position.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] In game music start offset and duration were incorrects
[*] [b]Improvement:[/b] Optimisation of the post process stage resulting on an overall performance improvement
[*] [b]Improvement:[/b] Integrate higher video quality (greetings to @Pseudohalogen on this one :)
[*] [b]New:[/b] Option to disable Desktop Window Manager to improve performance (thanks @VoodooMan for advice :)
[*] [b]New:[/b] Integration of Steam MiniDump support to provide us comprehensive feedback if the game crash.
[*] [b]New:[/b] Automatic in game recovering in case of a rendering crash.
[*] [b]New:[/b] Automatic saving before going through a Daoka or before playing a cinematic


[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/336610/discussions/0/626329820860443987/]Release notes history[/url]

notes.title: Outcast 1.1 update 1.1.2.18736 - Steam Overlay
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that Outcast 1.1 now supports Steam Overlay

[h1]Version 1.1.2.18736[/h1]

[List]
[*] [b]New:[/b] Full support of Steam Overlay !!
[*] [b]New:[/b] Add option to enable or not the usage of SteamAPI (default is enabled)
[*] [b]New:[/b] Borderless fullscreen support (set by default, user can still force native fullscreen)
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Improve fullscreen toggle, vsync and slowdown issues related to Directdraw buffer access
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Sound settings no more reseted when changing map and persistent between games
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Refactored ingame options menu 
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Potential crashes when leaving a map (ie end game cinematic)
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Save game can now be done without keyboard 
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Various bug fixes and stability improvements
[/List]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/336610/discussions/0/626329820860443987/]Release notes history[/url]
